decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the building(s) is/are occupied/used).

Condition : 3 - All new external finishes in respect of all works hereby approved (and any other incidental works to be carried out in connection with this) shall match the existing building in respect of materials used, detailed execution and finished appearance.

Condition : 4 - Full details to include sections at scale 1:20 (or as appropriate) of the proposed new elevation and door at basement level shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority in writing before any work on the site is commenced.  The development shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with the details thus approved.
Condition : 5 - The devlopment hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes ancillary to the residential use of the dwelling known as 28 The Butts.
description: Change of use of basement storage area to habitable room & erection of a wrought iron external spiral staircase from basement with new gate in fence
